Indikator 5 measures the incidence of ischemic stroke among prevalent atrial fibrillation patients, evaluating healthcare quality against a national standard of ≤ 0.8% [^src1]. The data tracks performance across national, regional, municipal, and health cluster levels over two consecutive reporting periods: July 2022 to June 2023, and July 2023 to June 2024 [^src1] [^src3].

At the national level, Denmark as a whole consistently met the standard, recording an incidence of exactly 0.8% in both the 2022/23 and 2023/24 periods [^src1] [^src3]. Regionally, [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] and [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] were the consistent leaders, both maintaining a 0.7% incidence rate across both years [^src1] [^src3]. Conversely, [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] and [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] were the persistent trailers, missing the target in both periods. Region Hovedstaden's incidence worsened slightly from 0.9% to 1.0%, while Region Sjælland improved marginally from 1.0% to 0.9%, though both remained above the 0.8% threshold [^src1] [^src3]. [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] saw a slight increase from 0.7% to 0.8%, barely meeting the standard in the second year [^src1] [^src3].

At the municipal level (2022/23 data), the lowest incidences (leaders) were recorded in [[toender|Tønder]], [[skive|Skive]], [[frederikshavn|Frederikshavn]], [[hjoerring|Hjørring]], and [[thisted|Thisted]], all achieving 0.4% [^src2]. The highest incidences (trailers) were found in [[norddjurs|Norddjurs]], [[samsoe|Samsø]], and [[morsoe|Morsø]], each registering 1.5% [^src2]. Several other municipalities, including [[struer|Struer]], [[syddjurs|Syddjurs]], [[laesoe|Læsø]], [[mariagerfjord|Mariagerfjord]], and [[rebild|Rebild]], also missed the standard [^src2]. Small island municipalities like Samsø and Læsø represent statistical outliers due to their very small patient denominators, which can cause disproportionate percentage swings [^src2].

In the 2023/24 period, performance was also evaluated at the health cluster level [^src3]. Clusters such as [[sundhedsklynge-soenderjylland|Sundhedsklynge Sønderjylland]] (0.7%) and [[goedstrupklyngen|Gødstrupklyngen]] (0.6%) performed well, while clusters primarily in the Capital Region, like [[sundhedsklynge-midt|Sundhedsklynge Midt]] (1.1%) and [[sundhedsklynge-nord|Sundhedsklynge Nord]] (1.1%), missed the target [^src3]. Additionally, [[klynge-vest|Klynge VEST]] failed to meet the standard in 2023/24 with an incidence of 1.2% [^src4].
